company_name: Sojo University, Kitada Laboratory (Precision Machining Laboratory)
semiconductor_relevance: High — Sojo University's Kitada Laboratory focuses on developing advanced materials for semiconductor packaging, specifically mold materials that enhance release properties.
summary: Sojo University's Kitada Laboratory specializes in the development of high-release mold materials for semiconductor packaging applications. Their research includes a novel cermet-based material, 'KH', which exhibits excellent wear and corrosion resistance, aimed at improving the efficiency of the molding process in semiconductor manufacturing.
